findings.title: Whitespace and multiline reference syntax bypasses pre-output security filtering
violated_contract: Plan Review R1 Repair Refinement: security before any output
findings.trigger: A reviewed PUBLIC guide contains [PRIVATE_TITLE_CANARY]( PRIVATE_CANARY.md ); the target is classified RESTRICTED. All names are synthetic fixture markers.
findings.mechanism: MD_LINK requires a destination immediately after '('; MD_REFERENCE cannot read a destination on the next line; raw HTML scanning excludes newline-containing tags. These inputs never reach local_markdown_target or the security classifier. select_documents then copies their labels/paths into raw snippets. Escaping them for HTML prevents an active link, but not disclosure.

confirmed_reproductions.commonmark: Installed markdown_it MarkdownIt('commonmark').render recognized all four forms with href="PRIVATE_CANARY.md". Kit view_inline leaves them as escaped/literal text containing the synthetic label; no XSS execution is claimed.
confirmed_reproductions.consumer_matrix: All 7 select_documents consumer values in current and explicit history mode return count=1 and both restricted markers for the whitespace form.
confirmed_reproductions.actual_cli: docs inventory/query/index --release release-2 --security PUBLIC, with and without --history: all 6 invocations exit 0 and expose both markers.
confirmed_reproductions.internal_html: Actual build_view for an INTERNAL guide referencing the RESTRICTED target returns complete=true; emitted HTML contains both markers and validate_view returns valid=true, code=MATCH.
confirmed_reproductions.public_html_limit: Direct PUBLIC build_view correctly returns APPROVED_EXTERNAL_INPUT_REQUIRED. This review does not claim that boundary was bypassed.
confirmed_reproductions.dependency_extraction: extract_typed_references returns zero entries for the four bypass forms versus one for the direct control. Confirmed parser omission only; a separate end-to-end stale-review exploit was not run.

evidence.expected: Reject the cross-boundary reference before ranking/snippets/HTML with a non-disclosing error.
evidence.actual: Selection and actual CLI expose restricted identifiers; internal HTML generation and validation succeed.

findings.test_gap: Existing parameterized coverage at test_document_lifecycle.py:718 covers percent encoding, same-line titles, code/literal links, same-line definitions and one-line HTML, but not whitespace after '(' or multiline destinations/definitions/tags.
findings.minimal_fix: Use one bounded full-document reference extraction/normalization path for security and dependency capture, or reject unsupported reference syntax before output. Cover valid whitespace/multiline forms, preserve source line locations and existing fence semantics, retain generic errors and Python 3.6/stdlib constraints. Reuse it in reference_visibility and extract_typed_references, mirror/reseal the payload, and add current/history/real CLI/HTML regressions before a new frozen review round.
